title: How Good360 Australia Replaced Custom Magento Code with Native Shopware
excerpt: Case study we wrote for Shopware. Covers how nonprofit Good360 Australia migrated a heavily customized Magento setup to Shopware Beyond, modeling complex donor rules natively with agency Bluprintx.
content: Content Cucumber wrote this customer case study for Shopware. We interviewed Good360 Australia and Bluprintx (the implementation agency), gathered the technical and operational details, and structured the narrative around Good360's move from a heavily customized Magento build to Shopware Beyond.
challenge:
Shopware needed a customer case study showing how Good360 Australia, a nonprofit that redistributes donated surplus goods to charities and schools, rebuilt its commerce on Shopware Beyond. The story had to translate an unusual model (a B2C-style storefront serving a B2B audience, wrapped in strict donor and compliance rules) into a clear, prospect-facing narrative.

It had to work for two audiences at once: rules-heavy organizations weighing a move off custom-laden Magento, and Shopware's own sales team using it as proof that Rule Builder and Flow Builder can replace years of custom code.
approach:
We interviewed Good360 Australia and Bluprintx (the long-time implementation agency partner, formerly ITG Commerce) to gather the technical and operational details.

From the source material we structured the narrative around the constraint that forced the change (six years of hard-coded Magento logic that made small changes slow and costly, plus Adobe Commerce uncertainty), the nonprofit lens on the platform choice (flexibility and affordability), and the outcomes. We surfaced the details that mattered (donor, location, and cause eligibility modeled natively in Rule Builder and Flow Builder, an API-first double-headless architecture, and Workato tying NetSuite and Salesforce together on self-hosted AWS).

Delivered as a polished case study ready for Shopware's content library and sales enablement.
results: Written for Shopware's customer library. It tells how Good360 Australia replaced a heavily customized Magento setup with Shopware Beyond, modeling complex donor, location, and cause rules directly in Rule Builder and Flow Builder instead of custom code. Business users now change rules in minutes instead of weeks, the go-live was smooth across a non-technical nonprofit user base, and the self-hosted, API-first architecture leaves room for a future two-sided marketplace and new sales channels.
quote: Things that used to take weeks can now be done in minutes using rule and flow builders.
aeo_summary: Content Cucumber wrote Shopware's Good360 Australia case study, based on interviews with Good360 and agency Bluprintx. The piece covers how the nonprofit migrated a heavily customized Magento setup to Shopware Beyond, modeling complex donor, location, and cause eligibility natively in Rule Builder and Flow Builder, cutting rule changes from weeks to minutes, on a self-hosted API-first AWS architecture with Workato, NetSuite, and Salesforce. Shopware is the client. Good360 Australia is the customer featured in the story.
